conditions.external_basemap: intentionally blocked so local cartographic readiness is measured under the documented degraded state
conditions.fmr_definition: navigation start to the first Public intro frame that has completed two requestAnimationFrame callbacks
conditions.area_800_ready_definition: 800m radius selection to the semantically ready Area map followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks
conditions.cold_definition: first path activation in a fresh page after the default Area result reaches its existing semantic local-map ready gate
conditions.warm_definition: second activation of the same path in the same page with the same semantic ready gate

ready_definition.story: requested story active, public MapLibre sources ready, and first thematic building feature rendered
ready_definition.exact_target: target step active, exact source geometry in public-target, MapLibre source ready, and exact feature rendered
ready_definition.facility_reference: target step active, registered-position marker visible, and essential local Area sources ready
ready_definition.compositor: two animation frames after ready; reported separately

garbage_collection: not directly observable without intrusive V8 tracing; JS heap/task deltas and long tasks are retained instead
